dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Baizhu. I want to go on the roof. To watch the fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: It's high up there. I don't wanna disturb the Finches down on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Qiqi, Finches just fly away as a precaution whenever they hear footsteps approaching. It's not because they're scared.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: We can't stay here for too long, I'm afraid. We still have patients to visit...

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Hmm... Okay. Patients are more important. Don't mind Qiqi.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: The busy period will die down after the festival ends, and then, I'll take you wherever you want to go — promise. Okay, Qiqi?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Let me write that down. In my notebook.
